name: Sigit Purnomo Said
description: '''Sigit Purnomo Syamsuddin Said''' (born 27 November 1979), commonly known as '''Pasha''', is an Indonesian singer and politician who served as Deputy Mayor of [[Palu]], [[Central Sulawesi]] from 2016 until 2021, and is currently a member of the Indonesian [[House of Representatives (Indonesia)|House of Representatives]] from the [[National Mandate Party]] faction. Before entering politics, Pasha was the vocalist for Indonesian iconic rock band, [[Ungu]] and joined Ungu in 1998.
